title: Mon 19 Oct 2026: AI selloff hits Nasdaq, UK jobs and CPI week, FCA illiquid fund redemptions consultation
summary: The Nasdaq suffers its worst week since June as chip stocks slide, while the FTSE 100 posts its strongest week in six months and Brent tops one hundred and ten dollars. UK jobs and September inflation lead into a Fed, Budget and ECB week. In regulation, the FCA's new consultation CP26/35 proposes ninety day notice periods for illiquid funds; in funds, new LTAF and ETF launches. Plus three COO action points and the diary.
